FunctionOutput_digitalocean_updatevpc.description: The confirmed VPC record returned by DigitalOcean after the update.

tags.instructions: Obtain a VPC ID from `list-vpcs` or `create-vpc`. Use this for metadata changes or to select the regional default; it cannot change region or address range. Omitted fields stay unchanged, and description='' clears the description. makeDefault=true selects this VPC and removes default status from the previous default in the same region. You cannot directly unset default status; select another VPC instead. Use `get-vpc` to inspect the current state. Concurrent changes are not guaranteed to be protected.
